Your guide

Meet Oshika

I have walked this path. For over 10 years, I navigated the grief, confusion, and disconnection that so many women on the conception journey know deeply.

What I found — through Ayurveda, nervous system healing, conscious connected breathwork, mantra, and ancestral pattern work — was that my womb was not broken. She was waiting to be heard.

I founded Merely Mindful to bring this medicine to women who have been failed by conventional approaches. Over 500 women have moved through my work across Ireland and beyond.

This 9-day portal is the most intimate ceremony I have ever created — designed to build the bridge between you and the soul of the baby who is waiting to arrive.

Questions

What you need to know

Do I need to currently be trying for pregnancy?

No. This experience is designed for women who want to prepare intentionally — whether they plan to conceive soon or in the future.

Can I join if I’m doing IVF or receiving medical fertility support?

Yes. This training is educational and complementary in nature and is not a replacement for medical advice or treatment.

Do I need experience with spirituality or meditation?

Not at all. Everything is guided and designed to feel accessible whether you are new or experienced.

Will recordings be available?

Yes. Recordings will be available if you cannot attend live.

Will there be practical guidance or only mindset work?

This training includes education, reflection, rituals, body-based practices, and practical tools you can integrate into daily life.

Can I join if I have PCOS or irregular cycles?

Yes. While this is not a medical treatment programme, we explore supportive lifestyle and wellbeing practices relevant to hormonal health.

Is this only for women with fertility struggles?

No. Many women join simply because they want to prepare consciously and enter pregnancy feeling supported and informed.

What happens after the 9 days?

You’ll leave with your personal next steps and an invitation to continue deeper work if that feels aligned.
